hint.en: Leave blank to use measure_power. Other relevant capabilities on this device (current, energy, voltage) are detected and tracked automatically — no need to add them here.

For variable-load devices (washer/dryer) whose power dips near zero between phases. A drop below the threshold doesn't end the session until it stays low for this long — the session's end is still backdated to the moment power actually dropped. 0 disables this (ends immediately on drop).

Ignores brief flickers above or below the threshold that don't hold for at least this long, in both directions. Useful for noisy power readings. Whichever is longer between this and the continuity window governs when a session actually ends. 0 disables this.
